listingTitle: Keep test code out of production dependencies
title: Keep test code out of production dependencies
why: Production code that depends on tests, fixtures, mocks, benchmarks, or examples can fail in packaged builds and reverses the intended dependency direction.
suggestion: Move shared behavior into production code and import it from both production and test code.
limitations: Only imports resolved by Code Buster's static dependency graph are reported.
The rule is disabled when tests or examples are explicitly included in the analysis.

Python package initializers that explicitly import and list an immediate test-support subpackage in __all__, plus conventional commands/test.py test runners, are treated as intentional test entry points.
